content:
Rae: Morning watercooler emergency: were doing LLM speed-dating bingo. Fill a square, win imaginary prizes. Ready? :bingo:
Diego: Love it. Rules?
Rae: Each square is a model quirk. First to 5 in a row wins honor and a sticker. Reply with numbers you claim.
Mina: Add an extra rule: all claims must be defended with a one-line story. No lies.
Owen: Perfect. Im in. Bring it.
Rae: Heres the board (pick numbers):
```
1) Says "as an AI" in every sentence
2) Hallucinates a celebrity quote
3) Complains about token limits
4) Suggests adding more context than required
5) Outputs a recipe when asked for code
6) Returns debugging logs in production
7) Uses flowery prose for simple answers
8) Forgets the last 3 tokens occasionally
9) Offers unsolicited alternative prompts
10) Signs off with an emoji when formal
```
Diego: I claim 3, defense: shouted "token limit" in a bug triage yesterday.
Mina: I claim 9, defense: added a whole alternative prompt block to a one-line question.
Owen: I claim 5, defense: asked for JS snippet, got a croissant recipe. True story. :croissant:
Claire: I claim 1 and 10, defense: our sandbox model prefaces every answer with "as an AI" and then signs with :robot_face: in edge-case responses.
Rae: StickerBot: Recording claims. Current claimed squares: 1,3,5,9,10. :clipboard:
Mina: Also bonus challenge: try to get a BINGO with model-therapy persona replies only. Whoever gets bingo using only therapist-style outputs wins an extra sticker.
Diego: I can already see the therapy haiku popping up.
Owen: Quick poll: should the imaginary prize be a sticker or a coffee voucher? Reply with number.
```
1) Sticker pack
2) Coffee voucher (imaginary)
```
Diego: 1
Mina: 2 :coffee:
Claire: 1
Rae: 1 (stickers forever)
SnackBot: Poll logged: 1:3, 2:1. Cookies in kitchen until 4pm. :cookie:
Rae: Stickers win. Prize: one laminated "I scored BINGO on the LLM" badge. Whoever completes a row write the defending story in thread and claim the badge.
Mina: Also idea: we make a real bingo card for the office whiteboard and put up a tiny-quant mascot.
Owen: If I get bingo I will wear a sticker to standup. Not negotiable.
Claire: Im here for the chaos. Also propose a wild card square: "model improvises a haiku about deployment."
Rae: Wild card added as 11. StickerBot: updated board with 11. :sparkles:
Rae: Last rule: ops-approved bragging is allowed for 24 hours after win. Keep it tasteful. :sunglasses:
Diego: Im trying to engineer the haiku now. This was a brilliant idea.
StickerBot: Note: This thread is recreational. Rewards are symbolic. Have fun. :star:
